LanguageData.IcecreamTailMilkSeasoning.label: milk ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailMilkSeasoning.description: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nClassic milk flavor, without the fancy extras~ A taste of this tail gives a small boost to speed, aim, strength, and heat tolerance. Sometimes, the original is all you need.
LanguageData.IcecreamTailStrawberrySeasoning.label: strawberry ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailStrawberrySeasoning.descript: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nSweet strawberry is a natural match for ice cream. A taste quickens your steps and makes aiming faster and steadier, though your punches lose some strength~ If you prefer to shoot from a distance, give this flavor a try.
LanguageData.IcecreamTailVanillaSeasoning.label: vanilla ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailVanillaSeasoning.description: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nGentle vanilla and cream, with a surprising amount of get-up-and-go. A taste makes travel and work much quicker, and construction more reliable~ Worth trying when there's a long day ahead.
LanguageData.IcecreamTailMintSeasoning.label: mint ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailMintSeasoning.description: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nMint delivers an unmistakable chill. A taste improves heat tolerance, quickens your steps, and helps you strike more often in melee. Perhaps someone added too much mint~ Your breath becomes so very, very cold that you can even use it as a weapon.
LanguageData.IcecreamTailMatchaSeasoning.label: matcha ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailMatchaSeasoning.description: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nA slightly bitter tea flavor with a pleasant finish. A taste offers a little heat tolerance, though your steps and thoughts may slow down. Best enjoyed during a break~ This happens to be a certain great being's favorite flavor. Perhaps it will earn you their favor, meow.
LanguageData.IcecreamTailChocolateSeasoning.label: chocolate ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailChocolateSeasoning.descripti: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nRich chocolate that clears the head, quickens the feet, and adds a little persuasion to your words. The trade-off is less refreshing sleep~ The packaging also carries a specific warning: not recommended for sharing with big dogs.
LanguageData.IcecreamTailBeerSeasoning.label: beer ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailBeerSeasoning.description: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nMalty beer mixed into ice cream satisfies two cravings at once. Repeated tastes may impair your aim and coordination, but your punches grow heavier. Nivarians only grow stronger the more they drink. With enough, they might even recall some “special moves taught by the Matriarch”~ Just watch out for the hangover!
LanguageData.IcecreamTailFrostberryStompedSeasoning.l: traditional foot-stomped frostberry wine ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailFrostberryStompedSeasoning.d: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nPreserves the aroma and kick of traditional foot-stomped frostberry wine. A taste lifts the spirits, but leaves the hands less steady and the feet a little slower~ Authenticity comes at a small price.

Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nAn earnest imitation of traditional foot-stomped frostberry wine, though something seems to be missing. Its mild kick barely affects the hands or feet, but the pleasant mood fades just as quickly~ At least the aroma is convincing.
LanguageData.IcecreamTailFrostberryNiraSeasoning.labe: Nira's homemade foot-stomped frostberry wine ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailFrostberryNiraSeasoning.desc: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nFlavored with Nira's homemade foot-stomped frostberry wine. Unlike ordinary wine flavors, a taste leaves the mind clearer, the hands nimbler, and the steps lighter~ It puts you in a wonderful mood, too. “Just like Mama makes~~”
LanguageData.IcecreamTailNutmegSeasoning.label: nutmeg ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailNutmegSeasoning.description: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nThe label says “nutmeg,” but it's made from stone. The Matriarch once said that even a tail like this could taste of wine. A taste briefly clouds the mind and slows the feet. Yet some Nivarians say there are always little notes recounting the past tucked inside~ Supposedly, a nine-headed chronicler recorded those accounts without changing a single word and hid them in the stones.
LanguageData.IcecreamTailRainbowCandySeasoning.label: rainbow candy ice cream seasoning
LanguageData.IcecreamTailRainbowCandySeasoning.descri: Nivarians who already have an ice cream tail can use this seasoning to change its flavor, whether the tail is fully grown or recovering.\n\nA mixture of every seasoning, with unpredictable results. Each taste of the tail grants another flavor's effects at random, along with an extra mood boost. The tail also recovers a little faster~ The ultimate dream ice cream for every Nivarian who longs for an ice cream tail!
